title: Tariff Clause on the Share the Moment of Purchase Carries — Travel Protection Plans
content:
The destination loading owed on a Travel Protection Plans certificate is also taken at a share which the moment the cover was bought carries. The days between the day the certificate was issued and the first day of the journey insured are counted as whole calendar days.

Where cover was bought less than a fortnight before the journey began — fewer than 14 whole calendar days — the share the moment the cover was bought carries is 125 per cent.

Where cover was bought a fortnight or more but less than sixty days before the journey began — 14 whole calendar days or more, and fewer than 60 — the share the moment the cover was bought carries is 100 per cent.

Where neither holds, the share the moment the cover was bought carries is 75 per cent.

## The bands and their edges

| Whole calendar days between issue and the first day of the journey | Share the moment of purchase carries |
| --- | --- |
| Fewer than 14 | 125 per cent |
| 14 or more, and fewer than 60 | 100 per cent |
| 60 or more | 75 per cent |

The two edges fall as follows. At 13 days the first band applies and the share is 125 per cent; at 14 days the second band applies and the share is 100 per cent. At 59 days the second band still applies at 100 per cent; at 60 days the third band applies and the share is 75 per cent.

A share above the whole is intended: cover bought close to departure carries 125 per cent of the plan's destination loading percentage, a quarter more than cover bought in the middle band, while cover bought well ahead carries three quarters of it.

Hypothetically, a certificate issued on the 1st of a month for a journey whose first day is the 9th of that month stands 8 whole calendar days ahead of the journey, which is fewer than 14, so the share is 125 per cent. Issued instead on the 1st for a journey beginning on the 20th, it stands 19 days ahead, so the share is 100 per cent. Issued on the 1st for a journey beginning 75 days later, the share is 75 per cent.
